//: EASY CONFIG (Spanish). Same lesson structure as the Japanese course.

entries.note: Informal. Gracias works everywhere; this is just the short form.
The safe default with anyone - staff, hosts and strangers.
Warmer and more emphatic than a plain gracias.
Say it when leaving a shop, restaurant or hotel.
The reply when someone thanks you.
Handing something over, or inviting someone to go first.
The all-purpose please - also how you get a waiter's attention.
Multi-purpose: excuse me, sorry, and thanks for the trouble.
A softer apology - perdon is the everyday one.

entries.en: I don't understand. Please write it down.
Please take me to the hospital.
Please call someone who speaks English.
entries.bn: Llame a alguien que hable inglés, por favor.
entries.roman: Llame a alguien que hable inglés, por favor.

entries.en: Thank you for the food (before eating).
entries.note: Said before eating, like bon appetit - not the word for thanks.

entries.en: Thank you for the meal (after eating).
entries.note: Said after eating, especially to whoever cooked or paid.
Polite refusal - softer than a flat no.

entries.en: Please wake me up at seven.
entries.bn: Despiérteme a las siete, por favor.
entries.roman: Despiérteme a las siete, por favor.

entries.en: Can I stay one more night?

entries.bn: ¿A qué hora hay que dejar la habitación?
entries.roman: ¿A qué hora hay que dejar la habitación?

entries.en: I want to go to this address.
Where can I buy a ticket?
I'll get off at the next stop.
entries.bn: Me bajo en la próxima parada.
entries.roman: Me bajo en la próxima parada.

entries.en: I got on the wrong train.
I left my bag on the train.
entries.bn: Dejé mi bolsa en el tren.
entries.roman: Dejé mi bolsa en el tren.

entries.en: Please help me find my bag.
entries.bn: Ayúdeme a encontrar mi bolsa, por favor.
entries.roman: Ayúdeme a encontrar mi bolsa, por favor.

entries.en: Do you have a cheaper one?
Do you have a bigger size?
Do you have this in another color?

entries.note: You'll hear this in every shop and restaurant - no reply needed.
Polite staff acknowledgement that a request was understood.

entries.en: Nice to meet you (please be kind).
This is my first time in Japan.
entries.bn: Es mi primera vez en España.
entries.roman: Es mi primera vez en España.
